question: Which Rudras complete the eighteenfold enumeration?
premises: The list continues with Mukuta, Visara, Indu, Bindu, Prodgita, Lalita, Siddha, Rudra, Santana, Shiva, Para, Kirana, and Paramesha.
inference: The eighteen-Rudra group is completed by this set of named Rudras.
uncertainties: Some compound boundaries in the name list are compressed and may reflect traditional name groupings.
plain_english: Mukuta, Visara, Indu, Bindu, Prodgita, Lalita, Siddha, Rudra, Santana, Shiva, Para, Kirana, and Paramesha are remembered as the Rudras.
